t: Four instructions in a row, all of them negative
a: لاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا، وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا، وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ
p: Lā tabāghaḍū, wa lā taḥāsadū, wa lā tadābarū, wa kūnū ʿibāda-Llāhi ikhwānā. Wa lā yaḥillu li-muslimin an yahjura akhāhu fawqa thalāthati ayyām
m: Do not hate one another, do not envy one another, do not turn your backs on one another. Be servants of Allah, brothers. And it is not lawful for a Muslim to cut off his brother beyond three days.
